map.保证金 = 10 万 × 50% = 5 万。杠杆 = 1/50% = 2 倍。: Margin = 100k × 50% = 50k. Leverage = 1/50% = 2x. If the margin rate is 100% (no leverage), the full 100k is required.
map.初始保证金 50%、维持 30%：市值跌到使权益<30% 持仓市值时触发追保，需: Initial margin 50%, maintenance 30%: when the market value falls so that equity < 30% of position market value, a margin call is triggered and must be topped up.
map.初始为开仓冻结比例，维持为最低权益比例，低于则追保/强平。: Initial is the frozen ratio at open; maintenance is the minimum equity ratio, below which a margin call/forced liquidation occurs.
map.保证金率越低杠杆越高？: Does a lower margin rate mean higher leverage?
map.是。保证金率 10% 对应 10 倍杠杆，风险与收益同步放大，强平线更近。: Yes. A 10% margin rate corresponds to 10x leverage; risk and reward are amplified together, and the liquidation line is closer.
map.保证金比例（本页代码口径）：保证金比例=账户权益÷持仓市值×100（%）；联动量: Margin ratio (this page's code basis): margin ratio = account equity ÷ position market value × 100 (%); linked values: borrowed funds = position market value − equity (currency units; 0 with an explicit no-borrow note when equity equals the position), leverage multiple = position market value ÷ equity, decimal ratio = equity ÷ position market value. Validation: both fields are required numbers; equity must be > 0 (when it is 0 or negative the ratio and leverage are undefined — no more tiny-value fallback) and equity must not exceed the position market value (for the no-leverage / excess-margin case, enter a position at or above equity). Criteria: no fixed grading; a lower ratio means higher leverage, and dropping below the broker's maintenance margin triggers a margin call.
